periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, convergent toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoidal; vertical elongation is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of the patch.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Subtle downward tapering at the ventral pole, with the patch appearing slightly broader at the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thickness at the lateral flanks is approximately 0.25 to 0.30 relative to the total visible height of the torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between medial margins is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and semicircular with no visible flattening.
